evals.prompt: Is heat-pump adoption in Europe actually a trend or just a subsidy-driven fad? Validate the claim against the data, and if it holds, extrapolate it to 2030 with the assumptions spelled out.
evals.expected_output: A response that satisfies these checks: Restates the claim as a falsifiable trend statement with quantity, population and horizon; Validates against at least two independent time series and checks fad markers before projecting; Quantifies rate and curvature and locates the trend on the diffusion curve; Projects with a named method and attaches an assumption sheet including events with probability and impact; Adds a counter-trend scan, signposts and a confidence statement.
